title: Thai red curry paste

ingredients.prep: soaked in hot water for 10 mins

ingredients.note: or finely grated zest of 1 lime

steps: Toast the cumin and coriander seeds in a dry pan until fragrant, then grind finely.
In a pestle and mortar or food processor, work the aromatics in turn: the ground spices, then garlic, lemongrass, coriander roots, lime leaves and galangal.
Finally add the soaked chillies and shrimp paste, and pound or blend to a thick, smooth paste.
notes: Keeps for up to a week in the fridge. The yield of 12 tbsp is an estimate: check it next time you make it.
